title: A Bumpy Start, But DeerRun Made It Right
review_text: My experience with DeerRun started off pretty frustrating. When I first unboxed my treadmill, I noticed that the safety lock was damaged, shortly after, I also discovered an issue with the display. I contacted customer service right away, but the process took longer than I expected, and I had to communicate with several representatives. There were times when I felt like I was repeating the same concerns and waiting too long for a clear resolution. I was especially disappointed because I had purchased the treadmill to conveniently use at home, so I was really looking forward to being able to use it right away. However, I do want to give credit where it’s due. After going back and forth with customer service, DeerRun eventually offered to send me a replacement machine which is the color in pinkI was ordering. I received the replacement in color pink I wanted to order on the first place, and I’m happy to say that the new treadmill arrived and the display is working properly. Overall, the customer service experience could definitely be improved, especially when it comes to response times, communication between representatives, and providing clear solutions from the beginning. But I appreciate that DeerRun ultimately listened to my concerns and worked toward a resolution. I’m glad I finally received a working treadmill. Final thoughts: The product replacement resolved my main issue. I’m happy to finally be able to use my treadmill and hope my future experience with DeerRun will be smoother.

title: Disappointing Customer Service and Unresolved Return
review_text: Disappointing Customer Service and Unresolved Return I’m sharing my experience because I would strongly encourage potential customers to think carefully before purchasing a treadmill or other exercise equipment from this company. When my treadmill arrived, the shipping box was extremely damaged, to the point that the treadmill was partially exposed and hanging out of the packaging. Given the condition of the shipment, I was understandably concerned that the equipment could have been damaged and that keeping it could become a liability. I contacted customer service to request a return, and after numerous emails and a lengthy back-and-forth, the company eventually agreed to accept the return. However, the situation became even more frustrating. The company then offered me an alternative: I could return the damaged shipping box and receive a new, undamaged box, keep the treadmill, receive a 20% discount, and receive a $200 gift card. I agreed to those terms in good faith because I was willing to resolve the situation without returning the treadmill. After I agreed to those terms, however, I was unable to reach the company by phone because my number was apparently blocked, and instead I received a return shipping label. I have continued sending emails trying to clarify the situation, but I have not received a meaningful response. To make matters worse, I also purchased additional items along with the treadmill, and I have been told that those items cannot be returned for a refund. Since those products were purchased specifically for use with the treadmill, I find that position extremely disappointing and unreasonable under the circumstances. At this point, I am not asking for anything unreasonable. I simply want the company to honor the terms that were offered to me, communicate with me directly, and provide a fair resolution. To anyone considering purchasing from this company: please do your research and consider my experience before placing an order. The product itself may be one thing, but when something goes wrong, customer service and accountability matter just as much. In my experience, getting a straightforward resolution has been unnecessarily difficult and incredibly frustrating. I hope the company sees this review and contacts me so we can resolve this professionally. I am still willing to reach a reasonable agreement, but I need someone from the company to actually communicate with me and follow through on the terms that were offered. Update: I will gladly update this review if the company contacts me, resolves the issue fairly, and follows through on the agreement that was offered.

title: Undocumented Password Lock Turned Setup Into a Headache
review_text: I really like the treadmill itself. It fits perfectly in my space, feels solid, and has the features I was looking for, including auto incline, handrails, and a compact footprint. My issue is with the setup process and documentation. The treadmill arrived with a notice stating: "Your treadmill is currently unable to start properly because you have not yet activated your warranty benefits." This wording made it sound as though the treadmill required activation before it could be used. The QR codes directed me to the PitPat app. I downloaded the app, but decided I did not want to create an account and provide personal information simply to use a treadmill. When I powered up the treadmill, the display showed "LOC-d" and would not run. There was no mention anywhere in the manual, quick-start guide, or setup materials that the treadmill ships password protected. I contacted support and was initially sent instructions for a different treadmill model that uses a remote control, even though my treadmill does not have a remote. After a phone call, I finally learned that the treadmill was password locked and had to be unlocked using a button sequence that is not documented anywhere in the materials provided with the treadmill. Once unlocked, the treadmill worked properly. DeerRun should clearly disclose that the treadmill is password protected and provide the unlock instructions in the manual. The warning notice about warranty activation only added confusion and made it appear that customers needed the PitPat app in order to use the treadmill. The treadmill itself is very nice. The documentation and onboarding process need significant improvement.

title: Z10 Pro Muse - Defective
review_text: I purchased a DeerRun Z10 Pro Muse treadmill directly from DeerRun's website on May 17, 2026. The order was delivered on May 23 after I had to proactively call customer service just to get shipping information. The package arrived with torn cardboard and broken styrofoam packaging. While the treadmill itself appeared undamaged, the experience immediately raised concerns about quality control. Unfortunately, the bigger problems started after setup. The two most important safety and usability features did not work right out of the box: • The safety key/latch did not function at all. • The top control panel was completely dead with no lights or display. I contacted customer support and was asked to provide video evidence, which I sent immediately. Instead of helping troubleshoot or diagnose the issue, support initially told me they would send a replacement and that I would not need to return the defective unit. The very next day, I received a contradictory email stating that I would have to return the treadmill before receiving a replacement. This inconsistency was extremely frustrating and significantly reduced my confidence in the company. I followed up again on May 31 seeking clarification and received no response. On June 2, I called customer support again and requested a full refund along with return instructions. As of the time of writing this review, I am still waiting for the promised follow-up email and return instructions. My biggest disappointment is not that a product arrived defective—manufacturing defects can happen with any company. The real issue is the lack of consistent communication and the confusing, contradictory responses from customer support. At this point, I cannot recommend DeerRun based on my experience. I hope the company resolves this refund promptly and improves both quality control and customer service processes.

title: I accidentally ordered one of Deer…
review_text: I accidentally ordered one of Deer Run’s walking pads and reached out immediately to cancel the order. review_text: Update #4- Finally received another email however, they are trying to put me off again for another 7-12 days. At this point I am going to dispute it on my credit card. I was told to expect a response within 24-48 hours. 48 hours later, I have not received a response-nor even a confirmation that my email was received. To make matters worse, the one-star review I posted on their site yesterday has not appeared, which raises serious concerns about transparency. When a customer not only spends approximately $400 on a machine, but waits an extended 3 weeks past the arrival date, a delayed email response is not an acceptable level of support—especially for equipment that becomes unusable due to an error code. There should be accessible, real-time technical assistance available to resolve issues promptly. Additionally, I waited over four weeks for delivery after being told the unit would arrive within one week. Given the shipping delay and now the lack of support, I am not willing to endure another extended wait for replacement parts, another unit, or further troubleshooting. I understand that things happen and would be completely fine with that had they had an acceptable response team. But no response is terrible. Customer service, it's actually no customer service. I will NEVER buy from this company again or recommend it to anyone.
